post.description:
Sell a Regiondo experience through our own Stripe, then place a
permanent (non-expiring) Regiondo reservation for the chosen slot.

`slot` is the encoded id from /availabilities: ``variation999datetime999option_id``.
The flow is money-safe: we re-check stock before charging and refund the
Stripe charge if the Regiondo booking cannot be placed.
Cancel a placed Regiondo booking (releases the slot) and optionally refund.

get.description: All POIMeta records for the workspace — no hidden / relevance filtering.

Every POI for the workspace as GeoJSON.

No relevance threshold. ``bbox`` is OPTIONAL; when provided, results are
spatially filtered (same as the public endpoint). Without it you get the
complete workspace catalog.
All itineraries for the workspace — no visibility / user filter.

Every itinerary for the workspace as GeoJSON.

No visibility / user filter. ``bbox`` is OPTIONAL; when provided, it
drives geometry simplification (matching the public endpoint's behaviour)
so the payload is reasonable for the requested viewport.
All tags. Same `filter` JSON shape as the public endpoint.
All experiences for the workspace — no listed / active filter.
